location: Maryborough (Carisbrook Raceway), Central Goldfields, Victoria, Australia
nicknames: Home of the Redwood All-Trotting Carnival

main_all_weather.surface: All-Weather Crushed Bluestone Dust (Fast-draining granite cushion)
main_all_weather.stretch_length: 224 metres — equipped with inside Passing / Sprint Lane
main_all_weather.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). One of Victoria's fastest and best-cambered 1,000-metre provincial harness circuits, located at Carisbrook near Maryborough. Features sweeping banked turns, a 224-metre home straight, and an active inside Sprint Lane (Passing Lane). Mobile-start sprints (1690m) heavily favor fast Front-Row gate beginners ('E' style, Barriers 1-5) and the horse trailing on the 'Leader's Back' ('P' style, often Barrier 1 or Barrier 8), which gets an unobstructed inside shot up the 224m Sprint Lane.
main_all_weather.post_bias: FRONT ROW (1-5) & BARRIER 8 (LEADER'S BACK) GOLDMINE: Mobile configuration places 7 horses on the Front Row (Barriers 1-7) and up to 6 on the Second Row / Back Row (Barriers 8-13). Barrier 1 ('The Pole') and fast-breaking Front Row draws (2-5) command the marker pegs. Barrier 8 starts directly behind Barrier 1 — if #1 leads or trails the leader, #8 gets an economical marker-peg trip into the Sprint Lane. Wide Front Row (6-7) and outside Back Row (10-13) suffer heavy ground loss over 1690m.

handicapping_angles.sprint_lane_224m_leaders_back_pocket_pla: Maryborough's active 224m Sprint Lane makes the 'Leader's Back' (gardenia/pocket seat, 'P' style) the highest-value trip on the card. Horses drawn Barrier 1 (handing up to a superior favourite) or Barrier 8 (trailing #1) save 100% of their fuel for a 27-second final quarter up the inside Sprint Lane (+3.5 pts pocket/sprint-lane angle).
handicapping_angles.1690m_short_course_front_end_lock: In 1690m mobile sprints, the start is just before the winning post with a short run to the first turn. Horses that cross to the marker-peg lead ('E' style with 'is_lone_speed': true) win at an elite rate (+4.0 pts). Heavily downgrade backmarkers ('C') drawn wide on the second row over 1690m.
handicapping_angles.2190m_and_2690m_class_and_three_wide_tra: Over 2190m and 2690m routes, strong pacers/trotters in the running line ('1x1' or 3-wide with cover 'S' style) driven by patient top-tier reinsmen can loop tired front-runners in the final 400m.
handicapping_angles.redwood_trotting_headquarters_gait_manne: Maryborough is Australia's spiritual home of squaregaiting (hosting the famous Group 1 Redwood Classic & Victoria Trotters Derby). In Trotting races, clean gait manners are 80% of the handicap — heavily penalize trotters that broke gait ('galloped') in 2+ of their last 4 starts (-4.0 pts) and upgrade safe-stepping trotters off the Front Mark (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.premier_victorian_stables_and_reinsmen: Central Victorian and Melton powerhouses dominate Maryborough cards: trainers Emma Stewart, Andy Gath, Jess Tubbs, Brent Lilley, Anton Golino, Julie Douglas, and David Abrahams; and elite drivers James Herbertson (Maryborough specialist), Chris Alford, Greg Sugars, Kate Gath, Mark Pitt, and Nathan Jack (+2.5 pts).
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Standard mobile & standing-start distances: 1690m (Sprint), 2190m (Middle Distance), 2690m (Cup / Staying Trot).
